root_cause: The radios component only listens for click events within its own module element. Radio buttons in the same group exist in a separate module (#optout-radios). Keyboard navigation (arrow keys) triggers change events on the newly selected radio in the other module, which the original module never receives, so its conditional fields are not updated.
repair_strategy: Add a change event listener on the common ancestor form (or document) that triggers conditional visibility updates for all radios in the same group that have aria-controls, regardless of which module they belong to. Keep the existing click listener for mouse interactions.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can navigate the entire radio group with arrow keys and see conditional fields appear/disappear correctly when moving between options in different modules, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Multiple Radios instances on the same form will each attach a change listener, causing duplicate but idempotent updates.
The form lookup uses closest('form') which may not exist in all contexts; falls back to document.
Negligible performance impact from additional event listeners.
verification_requirements: Verify arrow key navigation from Text message to opt-out hides the mobile number field.
Verify arrow key navigation from opt-out to Text message shows the mobile number field.
Verify mouse clicks continue to work correctly.
Verify form data reflects selected value after keyboard navigation.
Ensure no regression in existing tests or functionality.
